doc: The high-resolution foot trial's views of its region (the hallux, toe 2 and the 1-2 web of the LEFT foot), in frame F (Frame.Foot.L, mm). Each looks along one of part 01's low-distortion directions (V5f, V1f mirrored to the medial side, V2, V4) from far off with a long lens, so the region fills the frame at a natural perspective (the far and near ends of the region within 1.1 of each other); hr.hallux and hr.toe2 are the 2048 px closeups of one toe's tip and nail. No depth of field: these judge form. Rendered by scripts/research/foot_hires/run.py with the registry of this file and p01.json.

presets.label: region_front
presets.note: p01.V5f's direction, aimed at the hallux and toe 2, a 92 mm field

presets.label: region_top_three_quarter
presets.note: p01.V1f's direction mirrored to the medial side (the region is the medial forefoot), a 100 mm field

presets.label: region_medial
presets.note: p01.V2's side, slightly from above: the hallux in profile, its pulp, nail and the first MTP prominence

presets.label: region_plantar
presets.note: p01.V4's view from below, tilted toward the toes' tips: the pulps, the plantar web and the flexion creases

presets.label: hallux_closeup
presets.note: the hallux's tip and nail from front, medial and above, a 46 mm field (45 px/mm)

presets.label: toe2_closeup
presets.note: toe 2's tip, nail and PIP knuckle from the front and above, a 42 mm field

presets.label: lesser_toes_closeup
presets.note: whole foot, pass 1 (2026-10-13): toes 3-5, their nails, webs and knuckles from the front, above and a little lateral, a 62 mm field

presets.label: plan_top_ortho
presets.note: the shape pass (2026-10-14): the foot in plan, a true top orthographic view straight down along -Z, toes up, the medial side on the right, 0.32 m wide at 2048 px (6.4 px/mm, as V1o-V4o); run.py renders it on a copy of the skin cut level at z 125 and capped (run.PLAN_VIEWS), so the leg above the malleoli does not hide the heel
